news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company has less than a year of cash runway based on its current free cash flow trend. Free cash flow: -₹2.8b This is considered a major risk. With less than a year's worth of cash, the company will need to raise capital or take on debt unless its cash flows improve. This would dilute existing shareholders or increase balance sheet risk. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Less than 1 year of cash runway based on free cash flow trend (-₹2.8b free cash flow). Negative equity (-₹27b). Earnings have declined by 27% per year over the past 5 years.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: ₹3.72 loss per share (vs ₹1.41 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹3.72 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹1.41 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹93.1b (down 12% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹7.92b (loss widened 164% from FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 28% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 13% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.18 loss per share (improved from ₹0.96 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹23.0b (down 7.2% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹383.0m (loss narrowed 81% from 3Q 2025).
